author: Fextralife
description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker - The Story So Far
In this Fextralife video, we're going to be discussing, what we know about the story so far in developer Rebel Wolves's upcoming dark fantasy RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker. We'll take a look at everything from reveal trailers to developer interviews parsing through the information and trying to make sense of it all. We'll also dive into the Romanian and German folklore that's influencing Dawnwalker's unique brand of vampiric lore.
